title: When the world sleeps… Heaven awakens its warriors. 🌅
paragraphs: When the world sleeps… Heaven awakens its warriors. 🌅
The fiercest battles are not fought with swords, but with prayer — before the dawn breaks.
Every tear, every whisper, every moment of surrender shapes the battlefield long before the sun rises. 🔥
This is where faith meets fire.

“The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.”
— James 5:16 (KJV)
